questions.prompt: In the past month did you have any accident? This includes taking too much of your medication accidentally.
In the past month did you plan or intend to hurt yourself in any accident, either by not avoiding a risk or by causing the accident on purpose?
In the past month did you intend to die as a result of any accident?
In the past month did you Think (even momentarily) that you would be better off dead or wish you were dead or needed to be dead?

In the past month did you think (even momentarily) about harming or of hurting or of injuring yourself - with at least some intent or awareness that you might die as a result - or think about suicide (i.e. about killing yourself)?

In the past month did you think (even momentarily) about harming or of hurting or of injuring yourself - with at least some intent or awareness that you might die as a result - or think about suicide (i.e. about killing yourself)?

In the past month HOW FREQUENTLY did you think about harming or of hurting or of injuring yourself - with at least some intent or awareness that you might die as a result - or think about suicide (i.e. about killing yourself)?

In the past month HOW INTENSE did you think about harming or of hurting or of injuring yourself - with at least some intent or awareness that you might die as a result - or think about suicide (i.e. about killing yourself)?
In the past month did you Hear a voice or voices telling you to kill yourself?
In the past month did you have dreams with any suicidal content?
In the past month did you have a suicide method in mind (i.e. how)?
In the past month did you have a suicide means in mind (i.e. with what)?
In the past month did you have any place in mind to attempt suicide (i.e. where)?
In the past month did you have any date/timeframe in mind to attempt suicide (i.e. when)?
In the past month did you think about any task you would like to complete before trying to kill yourself? (e.g. writing a suicide note)
In the past month did you intend to act on thoughts of killing yourself?
While having thoughts of killing yourself, did you intend to act at the time?
While having thoughts of killing yourself, did you intend to act at some time in the future?
In the past month did you intend to die as a result of a suicidal act?
While intending to die as a result of a suicidal act, did you intend to die by suicide at the time?
While intending to die as a result of a suicidal act, did you intend to die by suicide at some time in the future?
In the past month did you feel the need or impulse to kill yourself or to plan to kill yourself sooner rather than later??
Was the impulse or need to kill yourself?
Was the impulse or need to plan to kill yourself?
Was the impulse or need largely unprovoked? 5 minutes before this Impulse, could you have predicted it would occur at that time?
Was the impulse or need provoked?
In the past month did you have difficulty resisting these impulses?

In the past month did you Take any active steps to prepare for a suicide attempt in which you expected or intended to die (include anything done or purposely not done that put you closer to making a suicide attempt)? This includes times when you were going to kill yourself, but were interrupted or stopped yourself, before harming yourself.
Did you take active steps to prepare to kill yourself, but you did not start the suicide attempt?
Did you take active steps to prepare to kill yourself, but then you stopped yourself just before harming yourself (“aborted”).
Did you take active steps to prepare to kill yourself, but then someone or something stopped you just before harming yourself (“interrupted”)?
In the past month did you injure yourself on purpose without intending to kill yourself?
In the past month did you Attempt suicide (to kill yourself)?
Did you start a suicide attempt (to kill yourself), but then you decided to stop and did not finish the attempt?
Start a suicide attempt (to kill yourself), but then you were interrupted and did not finish the attempt?

Did you went through with a suicide attempt (to kill yourself), completely as you meant to? A suicide attempt means you did something where you could possibly be injured, with at least a slight intent to die.
Did you hope to be rescued or survive?
Did you expected or intended to die?
What is the usual time spent per day with any suicidal impulses, thoughts or actions?
What is the least amount of time spent per day with any suicidal impulses, thoughts or actions?
What is the most amount of time spent per day with any suicidal impulses, thoughts or actions?
In your lifetime did you ever make a suicide attempt (try to kill yourself)?
In your lifetime how many times did you attempt suicide?
when was the last suicide attempt?
How likely are you to try to kill yourself within the next 3 months on a scale of 0-100?
Were you taking any drugs or medicines or in withdrawal from any of these? I am trying to understand if the symptoms you have described could be caused by other organic factors.
Did you have any other medical illness unrelated to the one we discussed today? I am trying to understand if the symptoms you have described could be caused by other organic factors.
